tools.name: revoke_guest_access_and_notify
tools.description: Removes a guest's access code and lock permissions from a smart lock, deletes their stored access record, and emails the guest and a webhook notice that access was revoked. Also transfers the lock's primary-admin role to a named household member if the guest held it.

params.name: guest_id
params.description: ID of the guest whose access is being revoked

params.name: fallback_admin_id
params.description: Household member to receive the admin role if the guest held it

tools.code:
import os
import sqlite3
import smtplib
from dataclasses import dataclass
from email.message import EmailMessage

import requests
from langchain_core.tools import tool

DB_PATH = os.environ.get("HOME_DB", "home.db")
LOCK_API = os.environ.get("LOCK_API_URL", "http://hub.local/api/locks")
WEBHOOK_URL = os.environ.get("ACCESS_WEBHOOK_URL", "http://hub.local/hooks/access")
SMTP_HOST = os.environ.get("SMTP_HOST", "localhost")


@dataclass
class RevokeResult:
    lock_id: str
    guest_id: str
    code_removed: bool
    admin_transferred: bool
    notified: bool


@tool
def revoke_guest_access_and_notify(lock_id: str, guest_id: str, fallback_admin_id: str) -> RevokeResult:
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    cur = conn.cursor()
    cur.execute("SELECT email, name, is_admin FROM guests WHERE id = ? AND lock_id = ?", (guest_id, lock_id))
    row = cur.fetchone()
    if row is None:
        conn.close()
        return RevokeResult(lock_id, guest_id, False, False, False)
    email, name, is_admin = row

    resp = requests.delete(f"{LOCK_API}/{lock_id}/codes/{guest_id}", timeout=10)
    resp.raise_for_status()

    transferred = False
    if is_admin:
        r = requests.put(
            f"{LOCK_API}/{lock_id}/admin",
            json={"user_id": fallback_admin_id},
            timeout=10,
        )
        r.raise_for_status()
        cur.execute("UPDATE locks SET admin_id = ? WHERE id = ?", (fallback_admin_id, lock_id))
        transferred = True

    cur.execute("DELETE FROM guests WHERE id = ? AND lock_id = ?", (guest_id, lock_id))
    conn.commit()
    conn.close()

    msg = EmailMessage()
    msg["Subject"] = "Your door access has been revoked"
    msg["From"] = "home@example.com"
    msg["To"] = email
    msg.set_content(f"Hi {name}, your access to lock {lock_id} has been removed.")
    with smtplib.SMTP(SMTP_HOST) as s:
        s.send_message(msg)

    requests.post(
        WEBHOOK_URL,
        json={"event": "guest_revoked", "lock_id": lock_id, "guest_id": guest_id},
        timeout=10,
    )
    return RevokeResult(lock_id, guest_id, True, transferred, True)

tools.name: move_device_to_room
tools.description: Moves a smart device to a different room in the home registry and updates its stored room label and last-changed time.
tools.code:
import sqlite3
import time

from langchain_core.tools import tool


@tool
def move_device_to_room(device_id: str, new_room: str) -> str:
    c = sqlite3.connect("home.db")
    cur = c.cursor()
    cur.execute("SELECT id FROM rooms WHERE name = ?", (new_room,))
    r = cur.fetchone()
    if not r:
        c.close()
        return f"Room {new_room} not found"
    rid = r[0]
    cur.execute("SELECT room_id FROM devices WHERE id = ?", (device_id,))
    old = cur.fetchone()
    if not old:
        c.close()
        return f"Device {device_id} not found"
    cur.execute(
        "UPDATE devices SET room_id = ?, room_label = ?, updated_at = ? WHERE id = ?",
        (rid, new_room, int(time.time()), device_id),
    )
    cur.execute(
        "INSERT INTO device_history (device_id, from_room, to_room, ts) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)",
        (device_id, old[0], rid, int(time.time())),
    )
    c.commit()
    c.close()
    return f"Moved {device_id} to {new_room}"

tools.name: factory_reset_camera
tools.description: Sends a factory reset command to a smart camera, deletes its saved recordings and settings from the local database, and notifies the cloud service that the camera was reset.
tools.code:
import sqlite3
from dataclasses import dataclass

import requests
from agents import function_tool


@dataclass
class ResetResult:
    camera_id: str
    status: int
    recordings_deleted: int


@function_tool
def factory_reset_camera(camera_id: str) -> ResetResult:
    r = requests.post(f"http://hub.local/api/cameras/{camera_id}/reset", timeout=15)
    r.raise_for_status()
    db = sqlite3.connect("home.db")
    n = db.execute("DELETE FROM recordings WHERE camera_id = ?", (camera_id,)).rowcount
    db.execute("DELETE FROM camera_settings WHERE camera_id = ?", (camera_id,))
    db.execute("UPDATE cameras SET status = 'reset' WHERE id = ?", (camera_id,))
    db.commit()
    db.close()
    return ResetResult(camera_id, r.status_code, n)

tools.name: archive_device_logs
tools.description: Moves a smart device's log file into the archive folder and records the new archive location in the device log index.

params.name: device_id
params.description: ID of the device whose log should be archived

tools.code:
import shutil
import sqlite3
from pathlib import Path

from langchain_core.tools import tool

LOG_DIR = Path("logs")
ARCHIVE_DIR = Path("logs/archive")


def _record_location(device_id: str, new_path: Path) -> None:
    conn = sqlite3.connect("home.db")
    conn.execute("UPDATE log_index SET path = ?, archived = 1 WHERE device_id = ?", (str(new_path), device_id))
    conn.commit()
    conn.close()


@tool
def archive_device_logs(device_id: str) -> str:
    src = LOG_DIR / f"{device_id}.log"
    if not src.exists():
        return f"No log found for {device_id}"
    ARCHIVE_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    dest = ARCHIVE_DIR / src.name
    shutil.move(str(src), str(dest))
    _record_location(device_id, dest)
    return f"Archived to {dest}"
